rows.organisme: Conselho de Arquitetura e Urbanismo do Brasil
rows.notes: Lei 12.378/2010 (verified): compulsory registro, practice and title protected, one RRT per project. Live counter verified on 5 August 2026 on “Ache um Arquiteto”: 244,604 active professionals (public nominal directory). IGEO (igeo.caubr.gov.br) advertises “consulta, visualização e download” (official article of 16 April 2025: 236,085 architects, 37,180 firms, 11.67 M RRT). PITFALL: caubr.gov.br and transparencia return 403 to robots/from outside Brazil — the bulk nominal export could not be verified from abroad, hence B and not A (very probably available through IGEO/dados abertos). UIA: the Brazilian section is the IAB, not the CAU. Attempt of 5 August 2026: igeo.caubr.gov.br AND transparencia.caubr.gov.br/dadosabertos return 403 from outside Brazil (verified) — the nominal harvest will have to wait for local access or help on the ground.

rows.organisme: Provincial colegios and consejos (24 jurisdictions), federated by the Federación Argentina de Entidades de Arquitectos
rows.notes: Regulation PROVINCE BY PROVINCE: matrícula compulsory in each jurisdiction; in the City of Buenos Aires, the CPAU (Decreto-Ley 6070/1958 ratified by Ley 14.467). Headcount: “115,000 matriculados en todas las entidades” (first FADEA meeting of 2023, relayed by the Misiones colegio; 105,000 cited during COVID). No single national register: public padrones PROVINCE BY PROVINCE (verified: CAPSF Santa Fe; Córdoba publishes a monthly list). PITFALL: cpau.org is an SPA (every URL returns 200). FADEA = UIA section; fadea.org.ar publishes no figures.

rows.organisme: Colegio de Arquitectos de Chile (VOLUNTARY membership since 1981)
rows.notes: A documented REVERSE CASE: Decreto Ley 3.621 of 3 February 1981 (text verified on LeyChile) turned the colegios into asociaciones gremiales and PROHIBITED making membership a condition of practice (art. 2). Practice rests on the university degree (checked for the signing of permits — hence protected title). The RNA “Registro Nacional de Arquitectos Colegiados” can be searched by RUT (registrocolegiados.cl, verified) but covers ONLY voluntary members — grade D: no count of the profession as a whole exists. No recent headcount verifiable. UIA section: Colegio de Arquitectos de Chile.

rows.organisme: Consejo Profesional Nacional de Arquitectura y sus Profesiones Auxiliares
rows.notes: Compulsory national matrícula profesional (Ley 435 de 1998). 96,335 professionals holding a matrícula as at 30 November 2025 (the CPNAA's Datos Abiertos page, verified; 76,985 in October 2019). Search by cédula through the Oficina Virtual (account required); list of those sanctioned public. Genuine OPEN DATA: Socrata dataset on datos.gov.co (pymi-7cgj, verified through the API: 5,702 rows, updated 29 July 2026) — PITFALL: it covers only the matrículas issued since 1 January 2025 and is anonymised (no names); + XLSX aggregated by department/gender. Annual flow: 3,848 matrículas issued in 2024. SCA = UIA section.

Compulsory colegiación (Ley 14085 de 1962, Ley 16053, Ley 28966). National public “Buscador de Arquitectos” (verified 5 August 2026, data current to that day; public API returning colegiatura, names, habilitación ESTADO, regional council). “More than 27,000 architects” (Constructivo, February 2023, verified). A “Reporte del Agremiado” consolidated to May 2026 exists but is distributed through lnk.bio (blocked to robots). Distinguish colegiatura (registration) from habilitación (in good standing, required in order to sign).

rows.organisme: Colegio de Arquitectos del Ecuador (VOLUNTARY membership since 2008)
rows.notes: Compulsory colegiación was declared unconstitutional (resolución 0038-2007-TC, 5 March 2008, reinforced by the 2008 Constitution): the CAE remains but membership is VOLUNTARY. Practice rests on the degree recorded in the national register of degrees (formerly SENESCYT, search by cédula, current URL verified). PITFALLS: an all-professions register, individual search only (no list and no count); cae.org.ec is the provincial colegio of Pichincha — no national portal (23 provincial colegios); “~16,000 members” circulates with no traceable source — not retained.

No professional order and no compulsory registration: the university degree suffices. The SAU (1914, voluntary) states “más de 2,500 socios” (verified 2026) — an ASSOCIATION headcount, not that of the profession. PITFALL: its “Registro de Profesionales” is a voluntary job board, NOT a register of practice. An indirect count is possible through the professionals' pension fund (184,300 affiliates across all professions, with no breakdown). Protection of the title not verified.

No professional order: the APAR is a voluntary association — Paraguay's UIA section and an FPAA member. PITFALL: apar.org.py no longer resolves (DNS dead, August 2026), social-media presence only — cite no APAR URL. No statistics and no register found; control of the signature would run through municipal registers (not verified).

rows.organisme: Colegio de Arquitectos de Bolivia — Registro Nacional de Arquitectos
rows.notes: Ley 1373 of 13 November 1992 (text verified on lexivox.org): registration in the Registro Nacional de Arquitectos is COMPULSORY (arts. 6-7); no project has legal validity without the signature of an authorised architect (art. 5). The official site displays “20,000 Arquitectos Afiliados” — a self-declared round figure, with neither date nor method. No online consultation of the RNA (grade C). Structured by departmental colegios.

rows.organisme: Colegio de Ingenieros de Venezuela (colegio COMMON to engineers + architects)

alternatives.nom: Colegio de Arquitectos de Venezuela (CAV, membre FPAA)

rows.notes: Law of 1958 (Decreto 444, verified): architects record their qualifications with the CIV in order to practise (art. 18). Public search by CIV no. or cédula (civ.net.ve/buscar-datos, no login, verified) — individual lookups only: no count and no architects/engineers breakdown (headcount null). MAJOR PITFALL: the CAV's former domain (cav.org.ve) has been hijacked and serves an online betting site (observed August 2026) — cite no CAV URL. No UIA section for Venezuela.
